svg.title: SS-31 doses posted on X vs. doses tested in people and mice
svg.desc: Log-scale chart in milligrams. Posted on X: a microdose plan of 2 to 3 mg a day and a 10 mg focus dose. Tested in people: about 3.5 mg by vein once in a heart attack trial that missed; 4 mg or 40 mg a day in a heart failure trial where both missed; about 35 mg by vein once in older adults, borderline; the Forzinity label dose of 40 mg a day for Barth syndrome; 60 mg a day for 48 weeks in the NuPower trial, which missed. Mice: 3 mg per kg once in old mice, about 17 mg human-equivalent.

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SS-31 doses on X vs. the doses actually tested

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mg, log scale. Trial doses by vein converted at 70 kg. No trial has tested 2–3 mg

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: under the skin, and no trial has tested any dose for aging outcomes.
